profile.headline: Software Engineer Team Lead at CNH
profile.geoLocationName: Dell Rapids, South Dakota, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer Team Lead, currently spending the majority of my time leading my team and driving velocity, directly getting my hands dirty with C#, Oracle, and creating back-end interface layers as needed to optimize integrations.

Specialties: C#, Oracle, Git, Azure ServiceBus

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.locationName: Sioux Falls, South Dakota, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: 2025: Started another large-scale ERP project to merge two separate instances of IFS (Apps 10 & Apps 8) into a single, consolidated instance to simplify the complexity and duplication of resources (and cost) incurred by supporting multiple disparate systems.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Oracle Database · IFS ERP · IFS · Oracle · Git

positions.title: Software Development Lead
positions.description:
2023-2024: Divested an additional division (Aerostar) that was sold off as part of the CNH acquisition. Worked on initial integrations into CNH systems and consolidation of tooling and licensing.

2022-2023: Sole development resource tasked with integrating IFS with EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for digital exchange of invoices, purchase orders & schedules with primary customers and suppliers. Led development team tasked with divesting 1 of the 4 divisions (Viaflex) that was sold off due to Raven's acquisition by CNH.

2018-2022: Led development efforts to migrate the company to a new ERP system (IFS). Over four years we successfully launched all 4 divisions of the company on the new platform and performed a major version upgrade. (IFS Apps 9 --> IFS Apps 10) To simplify integrations and encapsulate some of the complexities IFS, multiple .NET Web API's have been setup and developed to streamline interfacing with the new system.

positions.title: Staff Software Developer
positions.description: Created a PLC middleware service for our Engineered Films Division that uses Kepware and Red Lion Controls, to log resin consumption, line speed, roll lengths and melt temps from the extrusion and lamination lines to a database. This information is then summarized and pushed into their ERP solution, matching up active shop orders with the consumption coming off the corresponding line and fully automating this portion of the process.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Created an Angular/.NET MVC application to automate the capture of shift information for the EFD production floor, providing a significant improvement in productivity. Previously this information was captured on paper and given to supervisors, who then manually entered it in a local Access database, off of which reports were manually generated. The new system has a SQL back-end which ties into our MES solution, allowing us to audit our data consistency, as well as having real-time SSRS reports summarizing the information.

Migrated all source repositories over to an internal GitLab server.

Took ownership of a set of legacy PHP applications and migrated them to a new server while upgrading the versions of PHP/Apache that were being used to host them. Additionally made QoL improvements to the application and created a mirrored test environment.

Created an Angular dashboard which displayed EFD sales order shipping information in real-time, with robust sorting & filtering options. This allowed for real-time updates related to picklist/packlist information and status of trucks to be shared between the team.

Part of a team that leveraged the open source nopCommerce (https://www.nopcommerce.com/) eCommerce solution to create a customer portal site for Raven's ATD Division to provide an online product/service catalog supporting online orders, returns, documentation, software downloads, purchase order history, product registrations, activation keys, and other resources for our partnered dealers. This site is hosted in Azure and makes use of WebJobs and the Azure Service Bus to synchronize information between the portal site in the cloud and our on-prem systems.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Part of the team tasked with setting up the infrastructure to synchronize data (orders, materials, products, recipes, inventory, etc.) between an existing DB2 database and 3rd-party MES solution sitting on top of a SQL Server in near real-time for Raven’s Engineered Films Division.

Led effort to migrate source control from Mercurial to Git, personally migrating 76 repositories with history to Git. Consolidated (~12) core .NET repositories and submodules into a single repository.

positions.locationName: Sioux Falls, South Dakota Area · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Used Entity Framework & ASP.NET MVC 3 (Razor) to create a captive portal implementation for use by Endeka in controlling and throttling access to the internet and television service.

Used ASP.NET WebAPI to create a prototype replacement for a legacy XML-based API, heavily leveraging OData and IQueryable to allow for rapid development and a highly extensible interface.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Expanded skillset to include ASP.NET MVC 2, Fluent NHibernate, NServiceBus, RabbitMQ, and xUnit. 

Founding member of the ESPv3 team, which was tasked with making ESP modular and scalable. To accomplish this, existing Monorail views and controllers were replaced with ASP.NET MVC 2. The existing Castle ActiveRecord data access layer was replaced with Fluent NHibernate to support connecting to both SQL Server and PostrgreSQL databases. The existing Rhino Service Bus leveraging MSMQ was replaced with NServicebus using RabbitMQ, to provide a messaging framework that would work on both Windows operating systems and Linux operating systems.

Member of the PCI Compliance Red Team, which was critical to the final push made to get the PCI Compliance project to release state.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Learned Monorail, Active Record, jQuery, Castle Windsor, git, Lucene, and nUnit while supporting a client facing telecom selfcare / electronic bill pay portal (eCRM.)

Implemented the entire Voicemail web interface for ESPv2 from scratch on a highly aggressive deadline.

Primary eCRM contact point for EPB during 2009, responsible for all eCRM implementations and support. Solely responsible for implementing the eCRM portion of EPB Phase 2, which was the first live version of the integrated eCRM/webConnect web solution using OpenID. Solely responsible for implementing the eCRM portion of EPB Phase 3, which exposed eCRM functionality to 3rd parties via a WCF API and added major (Lucene) optimizations to the location search in New Account New Service.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Led the project that converted their current code base (~800,000 lines of code) from VB6 to VB.NET 2005. Handled initial logic reworking and restructuring. Analyzed code and reported high difficulty areas, along with pre-migration fixes that could be done. Tested viability of Interop assemblies in regards to using VB6 DLL's in .NET. 

Worked remotely, visiting the office roughly one day every two months.

honors.title: Dimensions in Action (Innovation)
honors.description: "Kwen spent several months working with the EFD team to develop a solution that would allow the division to accurately pull information from our extrusion lines resin blenders PLC system. The resin information being calculated by the PLC needed to be compared and synced to Atlas so resin consumption could be recorded accurately for production shop orders. The fix that Kwen helped develop allows resin consumption to be tracked from the blenders themselves instead of requiring human manual intervention to calculate the totals between Atlas and the PLC. Along with this, he built in additional logic to prevent and identify data entry mistakes revolving around resin consumption, which has drastically improved the accuracy of resin consumption and saved many team member's time trying to correct issues after shop orders have been closed. This has been an ongoing effort since Atlas project started and Kwen always persisted in helping to find the best solution for EFD, even when it wasn't the easy route. Thank you Kwen!"
honors.issuer: Issued by Erin Vander Werff · Dec 2019

honors.title: Dimensions in Action (Service)
honors.description: Brent, Kwen, and Tanner have all be instrumental in developing CRIM (Configurations, Reports, Integrations, and Modifications) items for Project Atlas. Without their assistance, dedication, and willingness to make changes on the fly, Project Atlas would not meet the business needs of EFD. Keep up the great work!
